description: A function's stack slot is reused by its caller after it returns. Accesses made after the frame is gone must not be attributed to its locals.

cases.reason: fill_status writes 24 bytes into buf[8] while its own frame is live.
fill_status stays in bounds; main's later writes to its own local are unrelated.
cases.xfail: point 2: frame bases outlive the function's return
